description: Free appointment start times of one professional, in the professional's own time zone (start_local) and as ISO 8601 with offset (start). Give either one date (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 90 days ahead) or a number of days from today (1-14, default 7). Only professionals with can_book = true have bookable times. Times can be taken by others at any moment; request_booking checks again.

days.description: Days from today when no date is given (default 7, at most 14).

lang.description: Language for the answer (ISO 639-1): es, en, pt, fr, de, it, zh, ja, ko, ar, hi, ru, id. Default en.

name: get_availability

start.description: Same time as ISO 8601 with UTC offset

start_local.description: Local wall time of the professional, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM
